title: 第19章 弱肉强食的世道第20章 悟性出众霸王断江

;;
见她似乎有些生气了，林青心中微暖。
知道这是邻家少女质朴的善意，再推辞反倒伤了人心。
他只好接过还带着温热的瓷碗，笑道：“那就谢谢小丫了，这闻着就很香。”
小丫见他收下，脸上顿时雨过天晴，露出出羞涩的笑容，低低说了声：“阿青哥，不客气。”
说完便立刻转身，几乎是逃也似的跑回了院子，砰地关上了门。
门内还传来何老汉婆娘的惊呼，“造孽啊，你这丫头，咋不拿碗回来。”
林青端着那碗豆腐，站在原地，摇头失笑。
他想了想，直接闷头就喝完了一碗豆花，终究也没有留下铜钱。
这份心意，用钱来衡量反倒俗气了。
回到铺子里，姐姐林婉正在收拾柜台，准备打烊。
看到林青端着的豆腐花，也有些意外。
林青简单说了是何小丫送的，林婉认真道：“小丫是个好孩子，她爹何铁匠虽然脾气倔，但为人正直，平日里没少帮衬街坊。”
“我看那小丫好像也对你有意思，要不我给你下聘？”听到这话，林青连忙摆手。
“姐，我现在还没这打算。”
“阿青，不是姐说你，你现在也到了成家立业的时候了，早点娶妻生子也好。”林婉脸色微微严肃，继续劝道。
“晚点再说吧。”
林青摇了摇头，喝完豆花之后，便要飞快逃离。
不经意间，将桌上的一张惠民贴碰在地上。
林婉看见地上的纸，像是想起什么。

她脸色变得有些沉重：“阿青，你等等。”
“怎么了，姐？”林青回头。
“下午的时候，回春堂李掌柜家的儿子来过一趟。”
林青心中莫名：“李文叔，他怎么了？”
林婉叹了口气，语气带着愤懑和后怕：“李文叔昨晚从铺子回家的路上，被几个蒙面的黑衣人给堵在巷子里，打断了一条腿。”
“那些人留下话，说这是给他的教训，要是再敢搞那个联名惠民联名贴，下次，就要他的命了。”
林婉继续道：“李文叔让他儿子传话，希望你有空能去他家里一趟，说有事情，要和你商量。”
林青闻言，脸色瞬间阴沉下来。
拳头不自觉地攥紧，指节发白。
看来潘家，已经不满这些时日的生意惨淡了。
不敢直接对身为武馆弟子的自己下手。
便挑中了相对弱势的李文叔，要杀鸡儆猴。
“我知道了，姐。”
“明天一早我就过去。”
content_en:
;;
Seeing that she seemed a little angry, Lin Qing felt warm in her heart.
Knowing that this was the simple kindness of the girl next door, rejecting it would hurt people's hearts.
He had no choice but to take the still warm porcelain bowl and said with a smile, "Thank you, Xiaoya. This smells delicious."
Seeing that he accepted it, Xiaoya's face suddenly cleared up, showing a shy smile, and whispered: "Brother Aqing, you're welcome."
After saying that, he immediately turned around, almost ran back to the yard, and slammed the door.
Mrs. He's mother-in-law could also be heard exclaiming from inside the door, "What a sin, you girl, why don't you bring the bowl back?"
Lin Qing stood there holding the bowl of tofu, shaking his head and laughing.
He thought for a while, then drank the bowl of bean curd without leaving any copper coins.
This kind of intention is tacky when measured by money.
Back in the shop, my sister Lin Wan was clearing the counter and getting ready to close.
Seeing the tofu pudding held by Lin Qing, she was a little surprised.
Lin Qing simply said it was given by He Xiaoya, and Lin Wan said seriously: "Xiaoya is a good child. Although her father, He Tiejiang, has a stubborn temper, he is an upright man and always helps the neighbors."
"I think that little girl seems to be interested in you too, how about I offer you a job?" After hearing this, Lin Qing waved her hands quickly.
"Sister, I don't have any plans yet."
"Ah Qing, I'm not telling you, it's time for you to start a family and start a career. You might as well get married and have children as soon as possible." Lin Wan continued to persuade with a slightly serious face.
"Let's talk about it later."
Lin Qing shook his head, and after drinking the beancurd, he ran away quickly.
Inadvertently, he knocked a Huimin sticker on the table to the ground.
Lin Wan saw the paper on the ground and seemed to remember something.
Her face became a little heavy: "Ah Qing, wait."
"What's wrong, sister?" Lin Qing turned around.
"In the afternoon, the son of shopkeeper Li of Huichun Hall came over."
Lin Qing was confused: "Uncle Li Wen, what happened to him?"
Lin Wan sighed, her tone filled with resentment and fear: "On his way home from the shop last night, Uncle Li Wen was blocked in an alley by some masked men in black and had one of his legs broken."
"Those people left messages saying that this was a lesson to him. If he dared to do that joint post to benefit the people again, he would be killed next time."
Lin Wan continued: "Uncle Li Wen asked his son to send a message, hoping that you could go to his house when you are free, saying that he has something to discuss with you."
When Lin Qing heard this, his face instantly darkened.
His fists were clenched unconsciously, his knuckles turning white.
It seems that the Pan family is already dissatisfied with the bleak business these days.
He didn't dare to directly attack himself as a martial arts disciple.
So he picked the relatively weak Uncle Li Wen and wanted to kill the chicken to scare the monkeys.
"I know, sister."
"I'll be there early tomorrow morning."
